lines.en: I crawl over a leaf slick with water
Droplets roll past me
Wetland leaves are soft and thick
Each step clings to the leaf
The leaf is slick, so I climb carefully
I am heavier than usual
Water drips from the leaf tip
I follow the trail of water
It is wettest by the reed roots
I inch across a film of water
The leaf moves and the water sloshes

lines.zh: 我避开叶子最滑的那块
lines.en: I avoid the slickest part of the leaf
Water slides off my back
I climb down the stem

lines.zh: 我贴着叶面蹭掉一点水
lines.en: I rub some water off on the leaf
All the paths in this wetland are soft
I lie on a vein, dripping

lines.zh: 这片叶子够湿，我很舒服
lines.en: This leaf is wet enough, I am comfortable

lines.zh: 水在我的毛上聚成小珠
lines.en: Water beads on my hairs

I eat nothing else

lines.zh: 我身体湿的时候颜色更深
lines.en: My colors are deeper when I am wet

lines.zh: 湿地叶面上，我慢慢抬头。
lines.en: On a wetland leaf, I lift my head.
The water covers other sounds
I have been here a long while
I need not go far to eat
The water on this leaf is fresh
I wait for the leaf to dry a little
Your boots are covered in mud
I am on this wet leaf
Too close, and the water will splash

lines.zh: 你手上滴着水，叶子都湿了。
lines.en: Your hands drip and the leaves soak.
I am slippery, do not pinch
Few people come to the wetland

lines.zh: 湿地叶面滑，我爬得小心。
lines.en: Wetland leaves are slick. I climb with care.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，水从头上滑下
lines.en: I look up and water slides off my head
You are about to step this way
Step back, the leaf will turn over
I slip and curl up
Water squeezes out of me
That soaked me through
Two hairs fell from me

lines.zh: 雨季的叶子，最嫩最好吃。
lines.en: Wet-season leaves are the tenderest.
It hurts, and I make no sound

lines.zh: 我慢慢舒展开，湿地的叶背很滑。
lines.en: I slowly unfurl; the wetland leaf is slick.

lines.zh: 我一沾就湿，叶子跟着弯。
lines.en: I am soaked, and the leaf bends with me.
I am still here, I did not fall
I will remember this wound
The leaf still has water on it, perfect
Set it closer, I will slide over
Wet leaves are the easiest to bite
I smell fresh sap
Do not wobble, I cannot hold on
One bite and the water comes out
This is far better than dry leaves
I am already wet enough
Give me one more leaf
I nibble my way along the leaf edge
Your touch made me slip
I nearly dropped off the leaf
Water splashed onto your hand
The leaf flipped and I held on
Now we are both wet
That bent the leaf down

lines.zh: 我滑到了叶子的另一边
lines.en: I slid to the other side of the leaf
I am too slick to grip
I am all water; do not touch me.
I only move once I am steady
There are more of my kind in the wetland

lines.zh: 叶上有别的毛虫留下的丝
lines.en: Another caterpillar left silk on this leaf

lines.zh: 两只在一片湿叶上会滑
lines.en: Two on a wet leaf would slip
I smell one very near
We regard each other across a droplet
On wet leaves we both grow slow
Neither of us crowds the other
Let us wait until the wings come
This wetland is big enough
Later it crawled away
Your grip and I slip
I am dripping all over
Put me back on a leaf
Wet things are harder to hold
I curl and the water squeezes out

lines.zh: 我身上的毛都贴在背上
lines.en: The hairs on me lie flat
Do not shake me, I will fall
I smell a leaf close by

lines.zh: 我扒着你的指头滑来滑去
lines.en: I slide around your fingers

lines.zh: 湿地的叶子又软又厚，我吸在上面。
lines.en: The wetland leaf is soft and thick; I cling to it.
That leaf over there is wetter
The water flows from over there
I go toward the water trail
That leaf still has water on its edge
This stretch is slick, I must go slow
I look for footing first
The leaves here are too thin
Something moved over there
I head for the shade and water
Once there, I can rest
I slide over little by little
The water trail is my road
One more leaf's distance
I stop and lick the leaf
The wetland is too loud, I cannot hear
Following the veins is steadiest
When the leaf sways, I must stop
I am too slick, speed means falling
The water there is fresh
Almost crawled there
I knock you with my head
I bite into your hand
I am slick, the hit does not land well
I lie across to block
I puff myself up

lines.zh: 这一下把我自己滑出去了
lines.en: That slid me right off

lines.zh: 除了啃叶我什么都不会
lines.en: Chewing leaves is all I know
A few of my hairs stood up
I bump you, damp and clumsy.
I will go back to my leaf
I come out on this wet leaf
The wetland has just had rain
The water on the leaves has not dried
I lick the leaf once first
Water sounds on every side

lines.zh: 我的身体比看上去更重
lines.en: My body is heavier than it looks

lines.zh: 我从一片叶子底下钻出来
lines.en: I come out from under a leaf
This is exactly wet enough

lines.zh: 我停在叶脉交叉的地方
lines.en: I stop where the veins cross
Water is dripping off the leaf edge
The wet leaf smokes, and I am baked too

lines.zh: 我从叶上滑下去，摔进水里
lines.en: I slip off the leaf into the water
Too much water, I cannot get free

lines.zh: 气浪把水花和叶子一起掀起来
lines.en: The blast lifts water and leaves together

lines.zh: 飞来的东西扎进我身体
lines.en: Something flying pierced me

lines.zh: 那股力把我压在湿叶上
lines.en: That force pressed me onto the wet leaf
No leaves, and hunger makes me limp
Lightning flashes wildly on the water
There is not one drop of water in the void
